summary: Seed analysis is partial. Predictions cover guaranteed item, loot, shop, and reward spawns plus structural floor layouts, checked against the pinned game version on the generation paths we have verified. Anything that depends on how a run was played — inventory, earlier drops, or choices already made — is reported as a constraint or left out rather than guessed.

implemented: Room layouts, connections, doors, and stair placement on regular dungeon floors
Fixed boss-floor layouts for the Sewers, Prison, City, Caves, and Halls, plus the final floor
Room-count and room-type tables for every region, including special and secret rooms
Floor-by-floor verification against the real game for a set of reference seeds
remaining: Verification is per-seed; an unusual generation path can still diverge
Later Halls floors need more coverage before layouts count as fully proven
Mining and vault side-levels are not generated
areas.impact: Room selection, sizes, connections, or the spawns that depend on them can differ from the game on an unverified generation path.

implemented: Layout and contents for covered special rooms, including Armory, Garden, Library, Pool, Crypt, Sacrifice, Toxic Gas, Traps, Sentry, Storage, Runestone, and Magical Fire
Secret rooms including the Garden, Maze, Hoard, Library, Artillery, Larder, and Chest Chasm
Prize generation for those rooms, including the private scroll pool behind the Secret Library
remaining: Some older room types still fall back to approximate contents
Terrain, traps, and plants inside a room are only verified where a reference floor exists
areas.impact: Terrain, prize positions, and the items inside an unverified room type may not match the game.

implemented: Guaranteed floor spawns — food on every regular floor, the Halls torches, Scrolls of Upgrade — reported with exact stack quantities when known and available to seed search

Ordinary floor loot from heaps, chests, locked chests, and skeletons, including class, stack quantity, upgrade level, and curse; results after an artifact draw carry the assumption that no artifact was obtained outside level generation earlier in the run

Quest rewards from the Sad Ghost, Old Wandmaker, Troll Blacksmith, and Ambitious Imp; the Ghost's armor class and shared upgrade level are exact, its weapon is named exactly or shown as a short ordered set, and its enchantment and glyph are named with the Parchment Scrap level needed to keep them; the Wandmaker's two distinct, non-cursed wand classes are exact unless Mimic Tooth can shift the deck, in which case they are shown as ordered candidates, with exact upgrade levels when known; the Imp's cursed +2…+4 ring is likewise named exactly or shown as an ordered set
Special- and secret-room rewards: how many drop, their categories, tier and upgrade bounds, and whether they are cursed
Shop stock presence and stack quantities, with identical fixed items combined, common items named exactly, and deck-driven slots reported as a category and tier
Seed search can additionally match a minimum upgrade level on items predicted exactly
remaining: Loot tied to an unverified room or generation path can be missing or misplaced
Some guaranteed spawn families still need verification against the game
areas.impact: A guaranteed spawn or one of its properties can still be missing from the report on an unverified generation path.

implemented: Floor maps show room shapes, walls, doors, stairs, water, grass, traps, and plants as painted during generation
Maps are published only when the layout itself cannot be changed by inventory or meta progress
remaining: Unverified room painters and later floors can render incomplete geometry, doors, or transitions
Quest side-levels, such as the Troll Blacksmith's mine, are not rendered
areas.impact: Previews show the deterministic floor layout — terrain, traps, plants, and water — captured before anything is placed in the level. They make no claims about NPCs, monsters, or where items end up.

implemented: Everything the analyzer predicts is derived from the seed alone
remaining: Player decisions and inventory changes are not inferred
Item identities that depend on what a run already found are reported as constraints, never guessed
Shop details that depend on bags, artifact history, or inventory are excluded
Exact placement cells are excluded; the claim is that a spawn is guaranteed, not where it lands
Mimic and golden Mimic contents are excluded because their generation and carried rewards can shift with run history
Maps show layout only — no monsters, items, or loot
The starting Guidebook page is not seed-determined and is excluded
Full-accuracy claims stay blocked while the overall status is partial
areas.impact: These inputs and behaviors are not predictions and should not be read as analyzer errors.
